camel_example: aliyun cloudfw DescribeControlPolicyDomainResolve --region cn-hangzhou --RegionNo 'cn-beijing' --IpVersion 4 --FirewallType internet --Lang zh --Domain 'example.com'
description_en: Queries the domain name resolution results of an access control policy
description_zh: 查询访问控制策略的域名解析结果
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw describe-control-policy-domain-resolve --lang zh --region-no cn-beijing --domain example.com --ip-version 4 --firewall-type internet --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeControlPolicyDomainResolve

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the error MissingParameter.RegionNo is returned (-200155, The required parameter 'RegionNo' is not provided.)
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。本参数必填，缺失时返回 MissingParameter.RegionNo（-200155，The required parameter 'RegionNo' is not provided.）
parameters.name: region_no

parameters.help_en: The domain name. This parameter is required and must be specified when you call this operation
parameters.help_zh: 域名。本参数实际为必填项，调用时需提供
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The IP address version. Valid values: 4 (IPv4) and 6 (IPv6).

This parameter is unconditionally required and has no dependency on RegionNo. If this parameter is not specified, the error MissingParameter.IpVersion is returned (-200157). If the value is invalid, the error ErrorParameterIpVersion is returned (-200135)
parameters.help_zh:
IP 地址版本。取值：4（IPv4）或 6（IPv6）。

本参数为无条件必填，与 RegionNo 之间不存在依赖关系。缺失时返回 MissingParameter.IpVersion（-200157）；取值非法时返回 ErrorParameterIpVersion（-200135）
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en: The type of the cloud firewall
parameters.name: firewall_type

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds, which represents the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970 (UTC)
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间。使用秒级Unix时间戳表示，即从1970年1月1日（UTC）起经过的秒数
